scenarios.name: Hide a panel while the ribbon shows compact group buttons

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon shows compact group buttons
the Parameters group button is visible
the user opens the compact ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels
the user selects Parameters in Show Panels
the other compact group buttons remain visible and close the gap
the user returns the ribbon to its expanded display
the Parameters panel is absent from the expanded ribbon
